en.name: Orange juice, freshly squeezed
en.summary: Freshly squeezed orange juice keeps 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 2–3 weeks in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). It is raw and unpasteurised, so it is not advised for young children, older adults, pregnant women or anyone with a weakened immune system.
en.pantry: No room-temperature timeline is given for fresh orange juice, and none should be. It is a sweet, unheated liquid carrying whatever was on the peel and the juicer, and between 4 °C and 60 °C bacteria multiply freely in it. Apply the two-hour rule: more than two hours out of the fridge and it goes, or one hour if the room is above 32 °C. A jug on a breakfast table for a leisurely morning is already at the edge of that.
en.fridge: 2–3 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, in a clean, closed bottle filled to the top, on a shelf rather than in the door. That is short compared with a carton, and the reason is simple: carton juice has been pasteurised and this has not. It also loses its aroma fast, so the second day already tastes flatter. Shake before pouring, since the pulp settles, and pour into a glass rather than drinking from the bottle.
en.freezer: 2–3 weeks at −18 °C (0 °F), which is noticeably shorter than the figure for commercially packed juice — worth knowing if you are planning around a glut. Freeze it in portions in containers with headspace, because the juice expands. The colour and the flavour both dull over those weeks, and the result is better in a dressing, a marinade or a cake than in a glass.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, and shake it well. Once thawed, treat it as fresh juice and drink it within the refrigerated window.
spoilage: Fizzing or foaming when poured, which means fermentation has started.
A sharp, alcoholic or vinegary smell instead of a sweet citrus one.
A bitter taste that was not there when you squeezed it.
Mould at the neck of the bottle or floating on the surface.
tips: Squeeze only what you will drink over a couple of days.
Fill the bottle to the top; air above the juice dulls it fastest.
Strain out the pulp if you want the cleanest flavour on day two.
Anyone vulnerable should drink pasteurised juice instead.

faq.q: How long does fresh orange juice last?
faq.a: 2–3 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or 2–3 weeks in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F).

faq.q: Can you freeze fresh orange juice?
faq.a: Yes, 2–3 weeks at −18 °C (0 °F). Leave headspace for expansion and expect the flavour to dull; thawed juice is best used in cooking.

faq.q: Is freshly squeezed orange juice safe?
faq.a: It is unpasteurised, so it carries a real risk of foodborne illness and is not advised for young children, older adults, pregnant women or anyone immunocompromised.

zh.name: 現榨柳橙汁
zh.summary: 現榨柳橙汁放 4 °C 以下冷藏可放 2～3 天，−18 °C 冷凍可放 2～3 週。它是生的、未殺菌的，不建議幼兒、年長者、孕婦或免疫力較弱的人飲用。
zh.pantry: 現榨柳橙汁沒有室溫的期限數據，也不該有。它是一種沒有加熱過的含糖液體，帶著果皮和榨汁機上原有的一切；在 4 °C 到 60 °C 之間，細菌會在裡面自由繁殖。請遵守兩小時原則：離開冰箱超過兩小時就倒掉；室溫超過 32 °C 時，一小時就是上限。悠閒早餐桌上放了一早上的那一壺，已經在邊緣了。
zh.fridge: 用乾淨、密封、裝到滿的瓶子，放 4 °C 以下、冰箱層架（不是門邊），2～3 天。比起紙盒裝短很多，原因很單純：紙盒裝經過巴氏殺菌，這一瓶沒有。它的香氣也散得很快，第二天就明顯變平。果肉會沉澱，倒之前搖一搖；並且倒進杯子喝，不要對瓶口喝。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 2～3 週，比市售包裝果汁的數字短得多——如果你正打算處理一大批柳橙，這點值得先知道。請分裝進留有膨脹空間的容器，因為果汁結凍會變大。這幾週裡顏色和風味都會變鈍，成品拿去做沙拉醬、醃醬或蛋糕，會比直接喝好。
zh.thawing: 請放冷藏解凍，不要放檯面上，之後搖勻。解凍後就當成新鮮果汁，在冷藏的期限內喝完。
spoilage: 倒出來起泡或冒沫，代表發酵開始了。
聞起來尖酸、有酒味或醋味，而不是清甜的柑橘香。
出現剛榨好時沒有的苦味。
tips: 只榨兩三天內喝得完的量。
瓶子裝滿到頂；汁液上方的空氣最會讓它變鈍。
想讓第二天的風味乾淨一點，就把果肉濾掉。
體質較弱的人請改喝經過殺菌的果汁。

faq.q: 現榨柳橙汁可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下冷藏 2～3 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 2～3 週。

faq.q: 現榨柳橙汁可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，−18 °C 下 2～3 週。請留膨脹空間，並預期風味會變鈍；解凍後拿去入菜比較好。
它未經殺菌，確實帶有食因性疾病的風險，不建議幼兒、年長者、孕婦或免疫力較弱的人飲用。
